question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Schools was brought to an abrupt standstill when the lockdown was imposed.
solution: The erroneous part is **'Schools was brought'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'Schools were brought'** should be used instead of **'Schools was brought'.** • In the given sentence '**Schools**' is **a plural noun**. • Hence, it should be followed by **a plural helping verb.** • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** ***Schools were brought** to an abrupt standstill when the lockdown was imposed.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'Schools was brought'** के बजाय **'Schools were brought'** का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में '**Schools**' एक **plural noun **है। इसलिए, इसके बाद **plural helping verb** होनी चाहिए। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4 **है। 35:Tef1, The correct answer is '**Amongst**'.
